verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs say current and past employees can view tax forms at any time through self-service, which suggests year-end forms are distributed digitally. They also say Rippling automatically calculates and files payroll taxes with the right agencies. However, no evidence names W-2s or 1099s, says these forms are generated automatically at year-end, or covers 1099s for contractors, even though contractor payments are supported. Missing for 10: explicit automated W-2 generation, 1099 generation and distribution for contractors, year-end processing documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
